source_text: Dominus regnans in aeternum et in saeculum et adhuc. Regnum non temporarium Aegypti; aeternum Christi. Hic finis cantici victoriae.
pass_a_gloss: Lord reigning into eternal and into age and still. Kingdom not temporary of-Egypt; eternal of-Christ. Here end of-song of-victory.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord reigning forever and ever >> Bible:Exodus 15:18]]. Not Egypt’s temporary throne — Christ’s eternal reign. Here the victory song reaches its crest.
